name: Index 5-Minute Opening-Range Drive
hypothesis: Canonical Zarattini-Aziz opening-range drive: the first 5-minute cash candle direction persists; stop at its opposite extreme; 10R or session end.
entry_conditions: Executable pure detect(snapshot), causally replayed with completed supplied candles only.
exit_conditions: Fixed declared SL/TP and horizon from executable output; common frozen execution policy.
stop_loss_method: One planned risk unit; stop at the opening M5 candle opposite extreme; 10R objective; flat 15 minutes before the cash close.
take_profit_method: 10R fixed target (most exits at the session time limit)
risk_model: One planned risk unit; stop at the opening M5 candle opposite extreme; 10R objective; flat 15 minutes before the cash close.
intended_conditions: Canonical Zarattini-Aziz opening-range drive: the first 5-minute cash candle direction persists; stop at its opposite extreme; 10R or session end.
limitations: No verified edge. M15 both-barrier candles need M1 (only since Jul 2026) and are otherwise AMBIGUOUS; CFD spread proxies; correlated instruments; broker holiday calendar unverified. M5 history only Jul-Oct 2026 (built from shared M1); exploratory, no independent out-of-sample split.

authorship.statement: Created by this actual Claude Code session; not attributed to Codex or Kimi.
